title: package-mac
responsibility: Owns the package-mac build or maintenance script.

errors.name: MacPackageError
errors.description: The command requires macOS, a supported invocation, and, for packaging, a matching Developer ID fingerprint and build keychain. Release verification requires the hardened stable Harness identity on the app and migration helper plus the Harness product name.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The release origin is missing or invalid, or Bun could not build the main or preload bundle.

errors.name: Node.js filesystem or subprocess error
errors.description: System commands and filesystem errors propagate. A staging, bundling, signing or verification failure leaves the existing dist/mac/Harness.app in place.
